title: EntityCard
description: The unit of fog-of-war. Everything renderable, speakable, or knowable is a card with discrete states. Image prompts, voice casting, and reveals all key off this object — module text never enters those paths directly.

pack.description: Owning campaign pack id; enforces the engine/pack boundary.

unrevealed_alias.description: What Pip calls it before identity is revealed, e.g. 'the scaled champion'.

states.description: Keyed by state id. A card is always in exactly one state; reveal transitions move it between states.

facts.description: Atomic, individually revealable facts about the entity in this state.

prompt_fragment.description: Original-language visual description used by the manifest renderer. NEVER copied from module text.

anchor_asset.description: Asset-store hash of the pre-rendered anchor for this state.

voice_id.description: Troupe member or dedicated preset id.

stat_ref.description: Engine stat-block id (SRD or pack-verified). Stats never live inline on the card.

gate.description: Required when mode is check_gated or event_gated.

revealed_to.description: Derived cache of reveal_fact events; the event log is the source of truth.

rules_notes.description: 2014→2024 reconciliation patches applied at ingestion review.

source_ref.description: Page/section pointer into the pack for the Prep Bench. Reference only — never content.

renderable.description: May this fact influence the visual manifest?
